Session duration, failure responses, statement content, posting and private navigation remain unobserved.

Only this explicit Western Dental catalog record is implemented; PersonaPay family tenants are not implied.
Recurring plans and future-payment schedules use public configuration limits with synthetic private eligibility, offers and execution; eBill remains unimplemented.
First slice activation is conditional on browser/domain/Infinity reference validation; no fidelity certification.
